name: @joinc/hi
description: Central manager for Claude Code add-ons (rtk + caveman + superpowers, extensible). One CLI to install, configure, switch modes, and audit token savings.
author: joinc <sunlley.evan@gmail.com>

scripts.test: node bin/hi.js help >/dev/null && node bin/hi.js status -f json >/dev/null && node bin/hi.js doctor -f json >/dev/null && node bin/hi.js list -f json >/dev/null && node bin/hi.js mode >/dev/null && node bin/hi.js skills list -f json >/dev/null && node bin/hi.js plugins list -f json >/dev/null && node bin/hi.js mcp list -f json >/dev/null && node bin/hi.js proxy 8899 >/dev/null && echo ok
